scenarios.name: light on when presence detected
light off when no presence

cases.utterance: Wire the Bewegungsmelder presence output to the Schlafzimmer Lichtsteuerung presence input so lights turn on when someone enters

Add checkout reset for the Schlafzimmer light: wire a VirtualIn 'Check-Out' through an EdgeDetection block. Connect the rising edge to the Lichtsteuerung reset-to-default input so all lights turn off on guest checkout

scenarios.name: dim scene when night timer active
no dim scene during day

cases.utterance: Night mode for Schlafzimmer: add a DayTimer with schedule 22:00-06:00, wire its output to the Lichtsteuerung Sel4 input so a dim scene activates at night

scenarios.name: presence activates light
warning dim before presence drops

cases.utterance: Presence-based light with warning dim: wire Bewegungsmelder.OutputPresence to the Schlafzimmer Lichtsteuerung.Presence, and wire Bewegungsmelder.OutputWarn to Lichtsteuerung.Sel5 for a pre-off dim warning before lights go out

scenarios.name: reading light toggles on button press
no toggle when button not pressed

cases.utterance: Bedside reading light toggle: wire PushButton through an EdgeDetection block. Connect the rising edge output to Lichtsteuerung.Sel6 in the Schlafzimmer for a reading-light mood toggle

scenarios.name: lights reset on presence drop
no reset while presence active

cases.utterance: All-off on leave: add a Not gate and an EdgeDetection. Wire Bewegungsmelder.OutputPresence into the Not, then the Not output into the EdgeDetection. Connect EdgeDetection.RisingEdge to Lichtsteuerung.Reset in the Schlafzimmer so lights reset when presence drops

scenarios.name: card-in enables presence
card-out disables presence

cases.utterance: Presence state machine with card-in memory: add a Memory block 'Zimmer belegt'. Wire Schalter 1 (card-in) to Memory.Input to set the room as occupied. Wire Schalter 2 (card-out) to Memory.Reset. Then wire the Memory.Q output to Bewegungsmelder.InputActivate so presence detection only works when the room is occupied

scenarios.name: light stays on after presence drops (off-delay hold)
light activates with presence

cases.utterance: Extended presence with off-delay: add an OffDelay block (10 minutes) between Bewegungsmelder.OutputPresence and the Schlafzimmer Lichtsteuerung.Presence so lights stay on after movement stops

scenarios.name: fan on when humidity high
fan on when presence active
fan off when no humidity and no presence

cases.utterance: Bathroom fan with humidity hold: wire Raumfeuchtigkeit Bad through a GreaterEqual threshold (>65%), add an OffDelay (10 min) on the output, then feed into Lüfter Bad.I1. Also wire Bewegungsmelder.OutputPresence to Lüfter Bad.I1 as a parallel trigger via an Or gate combining both signals

scenarios.name: bathroom light on with presence
bathroom light off without presence

cases.utterance: Bathroom presence triggers light: wire Bewegungsmelder.OutputPresence to the Bad Lichtsteuerung.Presence input so the bathroom light turns on automatically when someone enters

scenarios.name: fan on when humidity exceeds threshold
fan on when window open
fan off when nothing triggers
light on with presence

cases.utterance: Combined bathroom automation: presence triggers the Bad light, humidity triggers the fan with hold, and window open forces the fan on. Wire Bewegungsmelder.OutputPresence to Lichtsteuerung [Bad].Presence. Wire Raumfeuchtigkeit Bad through a GreaterEqual (>65%) to an Or gate I1. Wire Fensterkontakt Bad to the Or gate I2. Wire Bewegungsmelder.OutputPresence to Or gate I3. Wire Or gate output to Lüfter Bad.I1

scenarios.name: motion triggers light and fan
no motion means no light and no fan

cases.utterance: WC automation: wire the Bewegungsmelder presence output to both the Flur Lichtsteuerung.Move and the Lüfter Bad.I1 so motion triggers the WC light and exhaust fan simultaneously

scenarios.name: checkout resets lights
cleaning mode enables movement

cases.utterance: WC light with checkout reset and cleaning mode enable: wire a VirtualIn 'Checkout' to the Flur Lichtsteuerung.Reset. Wire another VirtualIn 'Reinigungsmodus' to Lichtsteuerung.EnMove. Also wire Bewegungsmelder.OutputPresence to Lichtsteuerung.Move for motion control

scenarios.name: fan on when humidity high
fan on when manual switch pressed
light toggle on rising edge
fan off when nothing triggers

cases.utterance: Fan logic with humidity and manual override: add an Or gate. Wire Raumfeuchtigkeit Bad through a GreaterEqual (>60%) to Or.I1. Wire Schalter 1 (manual fan switch) to Or.I2. Wire the Or output to Lüfter Bad.I1. Also add an EdgeDetection on Schalter 2 and wire the rising edge to the Schlafzimmer Lichtsteuerung.Sel6 for a light toggle

scenarios.name: card-in enables presence and lights
card-out resets lights to default

cases.utterance: Full bedroom presence circuit: add a Memory 'Zimmer belegt' for occupancy tracking. Wire Schalter 1 (card-in) to Memory.Input, Schalter 2 (card-out) to Memory.Reset. Wire Memory.Q to Bewegungsmelder.InputActivate. Add an OffDelay (15 min) between Bewegungsmelder.OutputPresence and Lichtsteuerung [Schlafzimmer].Presence. Add an EdgeDetection on Memory.Reset, connect RisingEdge to Lichtsteuerung [Schlafzimmer].RtD for checkout-resets-all
When I double-click the hallway button, toggle all lights in the house on or off

scenarios.name: long press activates goodnight mode
no press means goodnight stays off

cases.utterance: If I hold the bedroom button for 2 seconds, activate a goodnight mode that turns off all bedroom lights and lowers the blinds
Triple-clicking the garage button should arm or disarm the alarm system

scenarios.name: bright sunlight exceeds target
dim conditions below target

cases.utterance: Automatically dim the living room lights when there's enough natural light — try to maintain about 300 lux in the room

scenarios.name: evening timer active
morning timer inactive

cases.utterance: In the evening after 8 PM, switch the living room lights to warm white, and during the morning keep them cool white

scenarios.name: ramp enabled increases output
ramp disabled stays at zero

cases.utterance: 15 minutes before my alarm goes off, slowly ramp the bedroom light from 0% to 100% like a sunrise
Set up three buttons in the living room to choose between comfort, eco, and frost-protection heating — only one mode should be active at a time
Use a single button in the bathroom to cycle through 4 fan speeds: off, low, medium, and high — each press goes to the next speed and wraps around
Make the kitchen button multi-purpose: a short press toggles the kitchen light, a long press closes the kitchen blinds, and a double-click turns off everything in the kitchen

scenarios.name: morning and presence activates heating
no presence keeps heating off

cases.utterance: Only turn on the bathroom floor heating when someone is in the bathroom AND it's between 6 AM and 9 AM

scenarios.name: high CO2 and closed window triggers ventilation
low CO2 does not trigger ventilation

cases.utterance: If the CO2 level goes above 800 and all windows are closed, automatically open the kitchen window motor to ventilate

scenarios.name: TV on triggers blinds and dim
TV off resets

cases.utterance: When I turn on the TV in the living room, automatically close the blinds and switch the lights to the dim scene

scenarios.name: evening timer enables random gen
daytime keeps lights off

cases.utterance: While we're away, randomly turn different lights on and off in the evening between 6 PM and 11 PM to make it look like someone's home — use separate random timers for the hallway and kitchen
After a power outage, don't turn everything on at once — start the kitchen lights first, then after 30 seconds the hallway lights, and 30 seconds later the garden lights

scenarios.name: unlocked door and pulse triggers reminder
locked door suppresses reminder

cases.utterance: If the front door has been left unlocked, blink the hallway light every 30 minutes as a reminder until someone locks it again

scenarios.name: should open garage when car detected in dark
should NOT open garage when bright outside
should auto-close after timer expires (falling edge)

cases.utterance: When the Garagentor Sensor detects the car arriving and the Helligkeit sensor reads below 50 lux (it's dark), open the Garagentor. After 5 minutes with no further trigger, auto-close it via a Monoflop timer.

scenarios.name: should turn on garage light when door opens
should NOT be on when door has not opened

cases.utterance: When the Garagentor Sensor triggers (door opens), keep the Garagenlicht on for exactly 3 minutes using a StairwayLS block, then turn off automatically.

scenarios.name: should block garage door during storm (high wind + rain)
should allow garage door when wind is low
should allow garage door when not raining despite wind

cases.utterance: Block the Garagentor from operating during a storm: when Windgeschwindigkeit exceeds 60 km/h AND Regen is active, disable the Garagentor by wiring through a Not gate to cut the control signal.

scenarios.name: should disable irrigation when raining
should disable irrigation when soil moisture high
should allow irrigation when dry and no rain

cases.utterance: Disable the Bewässerungsventil whenever the Regen sensor is active OR the Feuchtesensor Garten reads above 60%. Use an Or gate combining rain and a GreaterEqual on soil moisture to inhibit the valve.

scenarios.name: should water when schedule active and conditions met
should NOT water when raining despite schedule
should NOT water when too cold despite schedule

cases.utterance: Set up timed watering: a DayTimer schedules the Bewässerungsventil daily from 06:00 to 06:30, but only if there is no rain (Not on Regen) AND the Außentemperatur is above 5°C (GreaterEqual). All three conditions must be met via an And gate.

scenarios.name: should switch to mains when cistern low
should stay on cistern when level adequate

cases.utterance: When the Pegelsensor (cistern level) drops below 20%, switch from cistern to mains water: wire the Pegelsensor through a Less block (threshold 20) and use its output to activate the Bewässerungsventil as mains water fallback.

scenarios.name: should run pump when scheduled and warm enough
should NOT run pump when freezing despite schedule
should NOT run pump outside schedule even if warm

cases.utterance: Run the Poolpumpe between 10:00 and 16:00 using a DayTimer, but disable it completely if the Außentemperatur drops below 2°C (frost). Use a Less block for the frost check and an And gate to combine schedule with frost protection.

scenarios.name: should heat when below target temp
should stop heating when target reached

cases.utterance: Control a sauna heater (use Lüfter Bad as heater output): a GreaterEqual block compares Pool Temperatur (repurposed as sauna sensor) against a target of 80°C. A HourCounter tracks total heater runtime and triggers a safety cutoff after 3 hours (Maintenance=3). Wire so the heater runs only when below target AND within the safety time limit.

scenarios.name: should close pool cover at sunset (no sunshine)
should NOT close pool cover while sunny

cases.utterance: Close the pool cover (use Jalousie 1 [Garten] as pool cover) automatically when the Sonnenschein sensor drops to 0 (sunset indicator). Wire Sonnenschein through a Less block (threshold 1) to detect sunset, then trigger InputTriggerDown on the Jalousie.

scenarios.name: should activate driveway heat on frost risk (cold + humid)
should NOT activate when warm enough
should NOT activate when humidity low despite cold

cases.utterance: Activate driveway heating (use Heizkörper Bad as heating output) when frost risk is detected: Außentemperatur below 1°C AND Luftfeuchtigkeit above 85%. Combine a Less block on temperature with a GreaterEqual on humidity through an And gate.

scenarios.name: should close valve when freezing
should keep valve open when warm
hysteresis: should remain closed at 1°C (between On and Off)

cases.utterance: Frost protection for outdoor water: when the Außentemperatur drops below 0°C, close the Bewässerungsventil. Use an AnalogThresholdTrigger with On=0 and Off=2 to add hysteresis — the valve reopens only when temperature rises above 2°C.

scenarios.name: should latch on mailbox open
should stay latched after mailbox closes

cases.utterance: Mailbox notification: when the Türkontakt Eingang (repurposed as mailbox sensor) triggers, latch a FlipFlop to remember mail has arrived. At 08:00 each morning, fire a PulseAt notification. The FlipFlop resets daily via a second PulseAt at 23:00.

scenarios.name: should turn on light on motion at night
should NOT turn on light on motion during day
should NOT turn on light at night without motion

cases.utterance: Outdoor camera light: when the Bewegungsmelder Garten detects motion AND the Helligkeit sensor reads below 30 lux (nighttime), turn on the Gartenbeleuchtung for 2 minutes using a StairwayLS. The And gate combines motion with darkness.

Electric gate control: open the Türöffner when either the Türklingel rings (intercom) OR the Schalter 1 activates (card reader), using an Or gate. After opening, auto-close after 30 seconds via a Monoflop with falling-edge detection.

scenarios.name: should open coop door at sunrise (bright)
should close coop door at sunset (dark)
should neither open nor close during twilight

cases.utterance: Chicken coop door automation: open the Jalousie 2 [Garten] (coop door) at sunrise when Helligkeit rises above 100 lux, and close it at sunset when Helligkeit drops below 20 lux. Use a GreaterEqual for sunrise trigger and a Less for sunset trigger.
